title: Cebu eyes year-end purchase of ₱50M sea ambulances for Camotes, Bantayan
summary: LAPU-LAPU CITY, Cebu — The Cebu Provincial Government is targeting the purchase of two sea ambulances by year-end as bidding advances for emergency medical transport services in Camotes and Bantayan.…

blocks.text: LAPU-LAPU CITY, Cebu — The Cebu Provincial Government is targeting the purchase of two sea ambulances by year-end as bidding advances for emergency medical transport services in Camotes and Bantayan. The P50-million project is expected to give residents in the two island groups another option for reaching hospitals when medical emergencies require immediate sea transport. Sea ambulance procurement The Department of the Interior and Local Government (DILG) has authorized the Cebu Province to proceed with the sea ambulance acquisition, according to Provincial Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office (PDRRMO) head retired Col.
